cmd:
set -e
docker exec caddy caddy validate --config /etc/caddy/Caddyfile --adapter caddyfile 2>&1 | tail -3
docker exec caddy caddy reload --config /etc/caddy/Caddyfile --adapter caddyfile 2>&1 | tail -3
sleep 2
IP=$(curl -s -4 ifconfig.me)
echo "cash-refresh: $(curl -sk -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -m 8 https://$IP/cash-refresh?probe=1)"
echo "UI: $(curl -sk -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://$IP/)"
echo "finrep-data: $(curl -sk -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://$IP/finrep-data?name=dashboard)"
